label: iPod Male Connector
description: iPod Male Connector This is the connector that will insert into an iPods. Use this connector to gain access to the various iPod pins. Schematic and footprint are not yet production proven. The PCB thickness must be more thin than the standard 0.062 FR4. Spark Fun Electronics SKU : DEV-00633
